facts.claim: Nepal requires at least one Sherpa or guide per this many foreign climbers on its peaks of 8,000 m and higher, Everest among them.

versions.unit: foreign climbers per Sherpa or guide
versions.note: for the 8,000 m peaks; below them, one guide per team. Tried before with little effect: no training is set for the guide, and Mingma Sherpa calls it more of a guideline than a rule

source.title: Alan Arnette: Everest 2026 rumor fire season (new rules)

facts.claim: Nepal's tourism bill would give an Everest permit only to a climber who has summited a peak of at least this height in Nepal. It isn't law yet: a recommendation, not a requirement.

versions.note: not approved: the bill was in committee in late February 2026

source.title: Alan Arnette: Everest 2026 rumor fire season (new rules)

versions.note: the bill was still before a committee of the House of Representatives in July 2026, and its rules unlikely to be enforced by spring 2027

source.title: Explorersweb: Changes to Nepal laws threaten stricter Everest rules, higher costs
